title: Standard-model source requirements

scopes.title: Fixed-design repeated predictive conditioning
scopes.checked_claim: Retain the fixed released design and complete joint covariance; repeated conditioning is a declared statistical comparison.
scopes.unresolved: Source selection/calibration dependence and the predictive data law are not established by a matrix fit.

scopes.title: Original ladder target with column 44 fixed
scopes.checked_claim: The frozen release has 3492 rows and 47 original columns. Fixing zero-based column index44 to literal0 leaves 46 active original coordinates (0–43,45,46), retaining every row and the full covariance. The older compact44-dimensional target is a separate identity.
scopes.unresolved: The released prior row44 has zero center and width, but its physical meaning remains unresolved. The frozen finite box uses source center±10width on the 46 active coordinates and a point mass at index44; original-coordinate units, source reduction lineage and normalized-measure interpretation remain distinct gates.

scopes.title: Supplied optical law through detector and censoring
scopes.checked_claim: A finite supplied-state optical law can be tested with separately specified detector and censoring rules.
scopes.unresolved: Nine systematic perturbations do not supply observed probability masses or a measured joint optical-response law.

scopes.title: Ladder axis and reduction identity
scopes.checked_claim: Sec2.1 Eqs1–6 preserve geometric anchors, Cepheid/SN calibration and the simultaneous covariance fit.
scopes.unresolved: Column44; failed M31/LMC reductions; SMC/LMC count discrepancies; several constraint meanings remain unresolved. Structural eliminability is not a physical label.

scopes.title: Ladder held-out dependence or changed model
scopes.checked_claim: A held-out test needs a frozen object/host/calibrator lineage and conditional covariance including the cross blocks.
scopes.unresolved: No independent held-out population or changed selection/calibration law is supplied by the existing ladder fit.

scopes.title: SDSS event, observer and velocity lineage
scopes.checked_claim: Heliocentric spectral/time redshift, CMB-frame redshift and peculiar-velocity corrected expansion redshift have separate roles; use exact multiplicative relations.
scopes.unresolved: The prior 321 structural joins and consumer event ledger do not establish complete physical event/frame identity; retain coordinate failures, source velocity-model ancestry and unknown cross-covariance.

scopes.title: Calibrated light curve to exposure units
scopes.checked_claim: Released FLUXCAL and its error are calibrated light-curve quantities. Preserve all source flags and epochs.
scopes.unresolved: Selected FITS photometry TUNIT cards are present with blank unit values; EXPTIME is absent. Clock standard, zero point, wavelength convention, extraction covariance and physical flux/electron bridge remain incomplete.

scopes.title: Calibration summaries to optical-state law
scopes.checked_claim: Original Table3 contains102 numerical rows and8 NA rows; the pinned NPZ has102 ordered labels and a102x102 fitted-offset covariance.
scopes.unresolved: The105 prose count and PS1/CFA3S filter aliases are unresolved. Fitted magnitude-offset covariance does not define transmission curves or measured state probabilities.

scopes.title: Empirical temporal template
scopes.checked_claim: SALT2 uses trained rest-frame phase/wavelength surfaces, per-event amplitude/shape/color and an empirical color law.
scopes.unresolved: B21 release training surfaces, exact units/support/interpolation, training uncertainty and physical detector bridge remain incomplete; color is not automatically a dust parameter.

scopes.title: Measured detector law
scopes.checked_claim: Gain/readnoise and calibrated extraction errors have separate detector and reduction roles.
scopes.unresolved: Raw exposure electrons, detector response/censoring/extraction covariance and a measured joint detector law are not supplied by these reduced products.

scopes.title: Thermal BAO compression
scopes.checked_claim: The pinned DESI DR2 fitted compression has13 ordered ratios with all169 covariance entries; the final Lyalpha pair is DH then DM. Table4 reports marginalized posterior means/stddev under reconstruction and nuisance assumptions.
scopes.unresolved: A conditional supplied-drag ruler is not predicted physical drag. Template/reconstruction/model domain, covariance conditioning and independent source/consumer acceptance remain required; cross-probe covariance is unknown.

scopes.title: Abundance and temperature law
scopes.checked_claim: Pitrou X_i=A_i*n_i/n_b is a pseudo-mass fraction; rho_b, average baryon mass, eta and thermal history specify the conversion to number densities.
scopes.unresolved: Supplied independent nucleus inventories and temperature histories do not implement BBN. Planck PArthENoPE1.1/neutron880.2s conditioning cannot silently become PRIMAT or an unrelated mass convention.

scopes.title: Observed RSD estimator and AP contract
scopes.checked_claim: BOSS DR12 uses explicit fiducial geometry, AP mappings, nonlinear power/bispectrum modelling, nuisance parameters, window and mocks. Table3 P+B and Table5 BAO+RSD f*sigma8 are different products.
scopes.unresolved: Window/mask/mocks/full covariance and estimator validation are not acquired. The same galaxy samples underlie BAO and RSD, so the compressed fits are not independent data.

scopes.title: Linear transfer and amplitude
scopes.checked_claim: Original Newtonian-gauge Einstein/fluid equations support the separately declared perfect self-interacting radiation+CDM+Lambda transfer and finite primordial-band variance. Its initial expansions are reviewer-derived.
scopes.unresolved: This removes baryons, collisionless relics, anisotropic stress and the photon hierarchy. Ordinary full-spectrum sigma8, faithful Planck transfer and independent numerical acceptance remain open.

scopes.title: Coupled non-LTE H/He kinetics
scopes.checked_claim: The separately named F_H1/NIST/RecfastCLASS singlet hybrid uses independent nuclei densities, shared electron charge, matter-temperature rates and Compton/adiabatic temperature evolution on a finite interval.
scopes.unresolved: Ground-state LTE is an artificial supplied initial boundary, not the preceding physical He history. Omitted HeIII, fit extrapolation below4000K, rate/atomic uncertainty and numerical controls remain explicit. Independently pinned H1/B2 and NIST atomic-data acceptance/serialization hashes are not certified by this source review.

scopes.title: Physical drag endpoint
scopes.checked_claim: Physical drag uses baryon-weighted Thomson depth from today and tau_drag(z_d)=1; comoving r_d is the sound horizon at that predicted endpoint.
scopes.unresolved: An interval ending at z300–600 omits the late opacity contribution. A qualified late/reionization continuation and tail/boundary budget are required; visibility and drag are distinct.

scopes.title: Selected source population
scopes.checked_claim: Observed sample cuts, light-curve fitting, simulated bias correction and systematic variant selection belong to the population law.
scopes.unresolved: S21 all-cuts across40 perturbations and B22 baseline-cuts plus BBC intersection are distinct source descriptions. Parent population, selection/censoring efficiency and variant execution ancestry remain incomplete.

scopes.title: Named strong-lens likelihood
scopes.checked_claim: B1608+656 uses lens/source redshifts, relative delays, imaging/PSF/dust/potential, aperture stellar kinematics and an environment-conditioned external-convergence prior.
scopes.unresolved: Full pixel/PSF/kinematic aperture data, delay covariance and line-of-sight prior assets remain missing. The template-derived velocity dispersion is not an SIS parameter; simulation prior is not a direct convergence measurement.

scopes.title: Primary CMB observable
scopes.checked_claim: A primary projection needs a closed photon/baryon/polarization/species/metric system, primordial normalization and sourced full visibility history. Dimensionless and Kelvin spectra are separate identities.
scopes.unresolved: Printed LOS survival/sign/coefficient issues are preserved separately from reviewer-derived MB-consistent repairs. Perfect-fluid transfer and finite thermal opacity supply neither primary spectra nor a measured Planck likelihood.
